Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class EclipseVFPExporter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.EclipseVFPExporter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EclipseVFPExporter extends Object implements Serializable
Formats supplied bottomhole pressures as OPM/Eclipse VFPPROD or VFPINJ records.

Inputs are standard surface volume rates (default Sm3/day), absolute pressures (default bara), datum depth in metres TVD, composition ratios in Sm3/Sm3 and gas-lift quantities in Sm3/day. setInputUnits(String, String) changes only the production/injection rate and pressure input units. setUnitSystem(String) selects METRIC or FIELD output and converts every dimensional axis and pressure. FIELD gas volume is Mscf, including gas/liquid ratios. Standard volumes must already refer to the reservoir deck's surface reference conditions; this formatter does not flash a fluid or change its reference conditions.

The supplied array order is [flow][THP][water ratio][gas ratio][ALQ]. Every combination is exported with one-based THP, water, gas and ALQ indices. Missing, non-finite or infeasible BHP values are rejected; no correlation, nearest-neighbour fill or extrapolation is performed. BHP must be the flowing well pressure at the specified datum. Process outlet pressures and throughput maxima are not BHP. This class qualifies the deck representation, not a well model.

Supported production definitions: OIL/LIQ/GAS, WCT/WOR/WGR, GOR/GLR/OGR, THP, BHP, and either no artificial lift (singleton zero) or GRAT. Injection supports OIL/WAT/GAS with singleton zero composition and ALQ axes. Other dialects and definitions fail explicitly.
